question: Should OpenClaw permanently adopt this provider-neutral `question.*` Gateway and public plugin SDK contract as the canonical human-input primitive?
rationale: The PR adds a new operator scope, protocol resource, public plugin SDK subpath, blocking agent behavior, and channel-wide message-claim semantics; repository policy requires explicit owner intent for that permanent API and product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the canonical contract
options.body: Approve the provider-neutral direction after the two correctness fixes, direct Codex contract check, conflict resolution, and attached live proof are complete.

options.title: Land an internal-only slice
options.body: Keep the Gateway and agent implementation private initially, omitting the public plugin SDK contract until external API semantics are separately reviewed.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer or close the PR if maintainers do not want a permanent cross-provider blocking-question primitive in core.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the canonical contract
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-neutral direction after the two correctness fixes, direct Codex contract check, conflict resolution, and attached live proof are complete.
